title: Rapyulus Panic
native_title: ラピュラス・パニック
overview:
A variety game brought to you by a lavish cast of 13+ characters, piled high with fun!! A must-check title for voice actor fans.

Rapyulus Panic is a collection of minigames hosted by a large cast of anime girls. Jump from one quick challenge to the next: spin a prize roulette wheel, play a hand of video poker, flip cards in a memory matching game, compare two pictures side by side to spot what is different, and take aim from a starship cockpit, along with more games of skill and luck.

- A wide assortment of minigames in one package
- A cast of 13 characters and more
- One player, memory backup saves

豪華13人+αのキャラクター達が贈るバラエティーゲームてんこ盛り！！声優ファン要チェックの1本です。
